channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Broncos ruled out Jonah Elliss (ankle) for Week 7 against the Cardinals.
item.description: Reporting from earlier this week indicates Ellis could be sidelined for a few weeks. Broncos S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) was also ruled out this week.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Pat Surtain (ankle) is questionable to play in Week 7 against the Cardinals.
item.description: Surtain never managed to practice in full this week. Keeping him sidelined until he is able to do so could make sense. The 4-2 Broncos are currently second in the AFC West. They face the 5-0 Chiefs in Week 8. Stay tuned.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Jonah Coleman (ankle) is questionable to play in Week 7 against the Cardinals.
item.description: Coleman practiced in full all week, but the Broncos could technically give him another week to rehab the ankle. If active, there are too many unknowns regarding Coleman’s potential workload to start him in the FLEX, but he must be rostered in 12-team leagues.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Broncos ruled out Tyler Badie (thumb) for Week 7
item.description: Badie is likely headed toward a demotion with Jonah Coleman (ankle) inching toward a return. The latter player is questionable to play this week.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Jaylen Waddle (chest) is not on the Broncos’ final injury report and will play in Week 7 against the Cardinals.
item.description: Waddle upgraded to full on Friday after logging two limited sessions to begin the week. The Broncos’ No. 1 wide receiver has struggled to deliver usable stat lines with Bo Nix intent on checking down. The Cardinals’ pass defense could facilitate a bounce-back game for Waddle, but he remains a WR3/FLEX at this time.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Drew Lock (right elbow) is questionable to play in Week 7 against the Chiefs.
item.description: The Seahawks’ backup quarterback is dealing with an injury in his throwing arm, so any calls for Sam Darnold’s benching will have to quiet down. Seahawks S Nick Emmanwori (hip), LB DeMarcus Lawrence (knee) and LB Uchenna Nwosu (hip) are questionable. The Seahawks ruled out Chazz Surratt (calf) and LB DrakeThomas (ankle).-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Vikings released RB Deejay Dallas.
item.description: He’ll likely find his way back to the practice squad — here or elsewhere — at some point this season. This move portends that Jordan Mason will be activated for Week 7.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Christian Kirk (calf) is questionable for San Francisco’s Week 7 game against the Falcons.
item.description: He is, however, expected to be activated off injured reserve and play. We’ve heard worse desperation options than “most accomplished 49ers wideout on paper playing with Brock Purdy and George Kittle as Mike Evans sits.” Kirk probably factors in the WR3/WR4 calculus assuming he is indeed activated on Saturday.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Nick Bosa (calf) will not play in San Francisco’s Week 7 game against the Falcons.
item.description: The 49ers keep projecting a rosy picture of Bosa returning to practice at some point, it keeps not happening. He’ll get the Week 8 bye to heal up. Bosa hasn’t played since Week 2. If only there were a reserve list that teams could place injured players on.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Seahawks ruled out Zach Charbonnet (knee) for Week 7 against the Chiefs.
item.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald told reporters that Charbonnet has not suffered a setback. He just isn’t ready yet. Many teams might rush a player of his caliber back, now that he is practicing in full, but the Seahawks are smartly taking the long view with Charbonnet’s health. Emanuel Wilson will function as the team’s leading rusher while George Holani plays on passing downs.-Nic Bodiford
